masked_raider_volume_revision:
Edit ONLY the middle SIDE view of this MASKED RAIDER front/side/back concept sheet to correct its flattened anatomy. The human partner identified that the profile feels too flat. Image 2 is the actual Goemon side view and image 3 is the actual Goemon front view: use their compact, volumetric anatomy as proportional guidance. Keep the left FRONT drawing, right BACK drawing, Goemon scale figure, all lettering, background, page layout, character height, ground baseline, palette, outfit and recognizable enemy identity unchanged.
Middle SIDE stays a true LEFT-FACING 90-degree orthographic profile, never a three-quarter view. Do NOT solve flatness by rotating him toward the viewer or adding a huge cloak. Draw real volume under his existing short indigo padded coat:
- A LARGE full round skull behind the mask, with visible forehead-to-occiput depth and a clear full curved back of head. Skull front-to-back depth should be comparable to its face height. The cream wooden mask is a thin, gently curved plate strapped in front of the human face, not the entire head. Show a small side cheek/jaw volume and breathing gap behind the mask edge; one ear and headband wrap make the head thickness legible. Avoid a thin vertical oval pancake head.
- A short thick neck supporting the head.
- A substantial rounded ribcage: chest projects forward and upper back projects rearward. Increase the torso's front-to-back depth noticeably, approximately30 percent over the existing side view, proportionate to the broad FRONT/BACK. Gentle abdomen curve under coat, not flat chest-to-pelvis vertical slab, not obesity.
- Compact but substantial pelvis/buttock depth, thick upper thighs, sturdy short calves and a deep oversized sandal. Distinguish chest, waist and pelvis contours rather than one thin tube.
- The anatomically left shoulder plate remains on the near shoulder and sits ON the full rounded ribcage. Shoulder and upper arm cylindrical volume, large hand. Place visible near arm slightly away from torso if needed to show chest and belly depth.
Keep head-to-body relationship Goemon-like: big head, short limbs, large hands/feet. Retain hair/topknot, wood mask, red belt, rope wraps, club in the anatomically right hand, and armor. Keep the same height as the existing front/back. Make the side silhouette full and believable yet strict profile, with restrained ink/paint shading indicating volume. No code, no model generation, concept illustration only.
